svg.text: 01 · Develop · a single photograph, no mask layer yet
A single photograph’s panel now unfolds. The head’s trailing side is + − ⋯; the two rows under it are the places drawing 27 of the Layers design reserved: the selection row
(Subject · Background · People) and the tool row (Brush, Linear Gradient, Radial Gradient | Eraser). With Film alone there is no Opacity and no buttons: those are a mask
With Film picked the column below is today’s. Using any tool with Film picked makes a new layer.
